behavior: Retain at most 512 original numeric sender reports per medium/route; encode exact u64 NTP as decimal text and exclude CNAME.
Retain at most 3100 completed original public audio queue receipts per route, with original RTP coordinates and source/submit/receipt monotonic times.
Report arrival minus source time only when a preceding same-SSRC sender report is within two seconds in both observation and RTP distance; never infer an anchor from a foreign SSRC.
Keep source submission age and queue wait separate; neither proves server admission or remote delivery. No paired AV or device presentation claim.

tests.coverage: Exact u64 fractional NTP, RTP wrap, future/foreign/stale anchor refusal, malformed report/order refusal, queue receipt versus source age, original failure cancellation with all twelve receive tasks joined and original completed receipt retained.
